//: A fake Key Manager for development. See Program.cs for what it is and is not.

Fake.//: Fixed rather than generated so compose, appsettings and this file agree without a bootstrap step. None of it is secret — it protects nothing but local test tokens.
Fake.//ExpectedToken: Not a secret the fake holds — the token it expects callers to present. Short and plainly fake on purpose: a long random-looking value trips the pre-commit credential guard, and rightly so.
Fake.//KeyPath: Must outlive the container: the key ring in Postgres is encrypted with it, so regenerating it would strand every credential already stored.
